# FixedConstraint

- Inherits [`Constraint`](constraint.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("FixedConstraint")`

A joint that holds two parts rigidly together, so that the solver treats them as one object. Unlike a `Weld`, both parts take part in the simulation: their masses add, and a force on either part moves both. Use a `Weld` to attach something to a character, and a `FixedConstraint` to build an object out of several parts.

This page lists the members this class declares. Inherited members are
listed on the page of the class that declares them.
